observations.title: Review terrain already discovered
observations.player_action: Open the world map with its configured binding and pan/zoom the recorded regions.
observations.outcome: The world map displays explored terrain and can provide textures to the companion minimap.
conditions: External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Explored terrain, native personal waypoints and official JEM boss/event markers have different owners. Native map/waypoint teleport sends permission-checked commands; JEM additions may apply only to official marker IDs.

observations.title: Select the correct saved map for a server world
observations.player_action: Use the map-selection menu and existing-map dropdown; inspect Server, Manual, World Spawn or Single mode.
observations.outcome: Different worlds at one address can retain separate maps; wrong selection can look like a reset.
conditions: Server mode needs server-side world identification; do not delete personal data to hide an identity mismatch.

observations.title: Navigate the native world map
observations.player_action: Press M, drag to pan and scroll to zoom, unless remapped; inspect the native control tooltip.
observations.outcome: The world map is explored terrain persisted by the client. Visible map controls can be customized without adding a replacement JEM map screen.

observations.review_note: Explored terrain is separate from private native waypoints and authoritatively discovered JEM boss markers. Native map settings, state identity and UI own presentation. Upstream features do not authorize publishing personal coordinates.

observations.title: Follow server world-map restrictions
observations.player_action: Use the map with its enforced profile and any required hotbar/equipped item.
observations.outcome: The author documents rank-based server profiles, mapItemId gating and a native no-world-map effect with a harmful variant. These govern access separately from waypoint teleport permission.

observations.title: Interpret native map overlays by their owner
observations.player_action: Use resource packs or supported claim/ally overlays with the native map.
observations.outcome: Resource-pack changes regenerate map textures; Open Parties and Claims owns its claim/ally integration. Map coloration or recent footsteps are not server-authoritative boss discovery.
